references.title: References
references.text1: I work independently and in teams.
references.text2: Here’s what colleagues say about me.

card1.name: Timo Böning
card1.text: Magdalena’s attention to detail ensured our project felt comprehensive and well-rounded. She professionally accepted and immediately implemented feedback. Her motivation to improve and solve problems as a team was evident throughout. Collaborating with her was incredibly fun. We shared an absolutely conflict-free dynamic where everyone contributed, feedback was taken seriously, and no one went on an ego trip.

card2.name: Bastian Wollny
card2.text: Magdalena impressed with her positive attitude, strong willingness to learn, and keen eye for detail. Particularly in the area of CSS, she quickly developed creative and clean solutions and implemented feedback professionally. Her open and team-oriented communication contributed to a productive and enjoyable collaboration. With her motivation and dedication, she made a significant contribution to the team’s overall success. Working with her was always a pleasure.

card3.name: Jermaine Jérôme Bärwolf
card3.text: Working with Magdalena was a great experience. She is incredibly open-minded, a fantastic listener, and brings a strong growth mindset to the team. Whenever faced with technical challenges, she takes the initiative to research deeply and asks the right questions to find the best solution. She handles feedback professionally, instantly turning constructive critique into better results. Her dedication to quality and mutual support makes her a wonderful asset to any team.
